evidence.text: Reduce the exponential-potential background to dimensionless phase-space variables, solve linear perturbations using Bessel/Hankel functions, and apply an Itô Langevin equation near a scaling fixed point. Separate the variance into propagated initial variance and accumulated quantum noise.

evidence.text: Uses a static spherical metric parametrized by A=e^(2h)f and B=f^−1, together with Einstein equations and a radial mass function f=1−2m/r, to motivate cancellation of the collapsing shell's gravitational mass.

sources.title: Conjecture on the avoidance of the big crunch

evidence.text: Order-of-magnitude estimates combine radiation density ρ_R ∼ T⁴ with the black-hole scaling T² ∼ M_pl⁻²ρ, giving ρ_R ∼ M_pl⁻⁴ρ². Replacing the density by ρ − ρ_R heuristically motivates a negative quadratic-density correction to the temperature relation.

sources.title: Nonsingular bounces catalyzed by dark energy

evidence.text: Choose anisotropy positions and velocities, solve for the turning-point radius, integrate in both directions, and classify endpoints and extrema. Compare pure-Λ scales using HΛt, HΛa and β̇±/HΛ.

sources.title: Nonsingular bounces catalyzed by dark energy

evidence.text: Restrict to a symmetry-invariant sector and analyze its exact metric through coefficient positivity, asymptotic ratios and stationary roots. The restriction removes the full multi-wall dynamics, so its three-bounce bound cannot be transferred to unrestricted Bianchi IX.

sources.title: Damped perturbations in the no-boundary state

evidence.text: Does an exactly evaluated, nonlinearly anisotropic minisuperspace implementation of the no-boundary path integral yield a physically acceptable state with damped perturbations? The paper examines how initial momentum regularity and the complex lapse contour affect disputed enhancement of anisotropies.
